description: The FIKWaste research team publishes time series of waste-bin volumes from three restaurant sites with kitchens in Portugal. Glass, paper, plastic and undifferentiated waste bins were monitored over consecutive four-week periods, with emptying events and deployment information supporting interpretation. The public OSF project identifies the collection and exposes a deployments CSV plus separate kitchen folders; the article documents the sensor and annotation methods. CC BY 4.0 permits free reuse. The observations can calibrate waste-generation profiles or test collection-scheduling simulations for commercial premises. The small set of kitchens and short monitoring windows are a limitation for generalisation to municipal or seasonal demand. Data payloads and sensor accuracy were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: FIKWaste: A Waste Generation Dataset from Three Restaurant Kitchens in Portugal
notes: G4-0440; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.

sources.note: Named public project and current description.
